title: Lower density of the weight is at least the multiplicity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with weight μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n], M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult). Let W ⊆ U be open. Then for Hⁿ⌞M-almost every x: if x ∈ W, then for every real c < θ(x) there is t₀ > 0 with c·ω_n·tⁿ ≤ μ(B_t(x)) for all t ∈ (0, t₀). Here ω_n = unitBallVolume n, B_t(x) is the closed ball, and c and tⁿ are entered via ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), 0 < n → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), x ∈ W → ∀ c : ℝ, c < R.mult x → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal c * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) ≤ R.measure (closedBall x t)
